analysis.rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosting/app is likely rendering inconsistent scholarship URLs across destinations for the GLOCAL opportunity. The visible content and official-source evidence exist, but the exact href value differs for UK, Spain, and Sweden in the rendered page or catalog data, so the automated check could not confirm link equality. This is commonly caused by destination-specific link generation, redirect wrappers, trailing-slash differences, query parameters, or mismatched canonicalization between the page content and stored catalogue history. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The participating institutions and official-source evidence are visible on the GLOCAL opportunity page, but the same scholarship link could not be confirmed for every destination. The recorded checks did not capture exact link equality for United Kingdom, Spain, and Sweden.

Observations:
- The opportunity lists University of Glasgow, Universidad de Los Andes, and Kyoto University among its study locations.
- Official evidence is shown with links to globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu and checked dates of 25 Oct 2026.
- The catalogue history reports one GLOCAL result for each of the seven destinations; exact link equality was not verified for UK, Spain, and Sweden.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Ensure the GLOCAL opportunity page renders one canonical, identical scholarship URL for every destination entry (including UK, Spain, and Sweden), rather than generating destination-specific variants or redirect/tracking URLs. If links are constructed dynamically, normalize them server-side so all study locations point to the same exact href string from globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu. Also make sure any metadata/catalogue records use the same canonical link string and not a redirected, encoded, or parameterized version for some destinations.
